scientific_contract.cartesian_basis: Right-handed orthonormal ab'c*: x parallel +a; y along positive b minus its projection on a; z parallel a cross b. Distinct from physical F/R/T.
scientific_contract.direct_matrix: A=[a b c], direct-cell vectors as COLUMNS; positive-diagonal Cholesky of the normalized metric scaled by a,b,c.
scientific_contract.plane_conversion: Signed Miller PLANE indices h=(h,k,l)^T: solve A.T n=h, so n=A^(-T)h. Signs retained. General direct [uvw] conversion A@[u,v,w] is not a GUI feature.
scientific_contract.orthogonalization: F=unit(nF); r=unit(nR); R=unit(r-(F dot r)F); U=F cross R. Front fixed; Right adjusted preserving projected signed sense. Preserve/report raw normals and all angular adjustments.
scientific_contract.top_policy: t=unit(nT); T=sign(t dot U)*U. Top selects hemisphere only; its raw normal need not be perpendicular. No guessed Top.
scientific_contract.top_rejection: Reject abs(t dot U) <= max(1e-8,128*machine_epsilon*cond(A)/sin(raw F,R angle)). This numerical guard is not experimental uncertainty.
scientific_contract.other_bounds: Positive finite lengths; angles strictly (0,180) degrees; positive-definite metric; reject minimum normalized-metric eigenvalue <=64*eps*maximum eigenvalue, cond(A)>1e12, sin(raw F,R angle)<=1e-10, noninteger/zero/nonfinite/oversized hkl. GUI |hkl_i|<=2^53; see G2 for callable-core validation ordering.
scientific_contract.physical_components: D=[F R T] columns; v_xyz=D v_physical; v_physical=D.T v_xyz. det(D)=+1 or -1; report handedness and F cross R=+T or -T. A left-handed D is not a proper rotation or an EasySpin right-handed Euler frame.
scientific_contract.standard_components: Q_standard=[F R U], separate right-handed computational reference; never relabel physical Top merely to force det +1.
scientific_contract.xyz_premise: Supplied XYZ is already Cartesian angstrom in this basis, assuming matching crystallographic/indexing convention. No inferred setting transform, reflection, molecular rotation or screen sign correction. Anchor movement translates arrows only.
scientific_contract.new_label_preference: r vector or principal axis of rotation; retain historical naming in original files.
scientific_contract.uncertainty: Printed float64 precision is not experimental accuracy. This converter does not infer a magnetic easy axis, fit EPR data or independently establish mounting/orientation.
